properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHA-256 used for non-security content digests: apps/web validatorHistory.ts:87 hashes "account:ValidatorHistory" to derive a cache-key prefix for validator-history RPC data; scripts/i18n/sanitize-docs-frontmatter.mjs:66 and verify-target-coverage.mjs:174 digest content for i18n build-time change detection. SHA-256 withstands Grover (square-root preimage); no PQ migration required, keep as-is.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Declared dependency: tweetnacl ^1.0.3 ships XSalsa20-Poly1305 (nacl.secretbox) in the docs-examples build; no secretbox call site found in the package. Note the A+ rating overstates PQ risk — XSalsa20-Poly1305 is symmetric authenticated encryption: Grover only halves its 256-bit key to ~128-bit post-quantum security, which remains sound; it is not Shor-broken.

properties.name: pqs:context
